description: Visualize risk with a clear Power BI risk matrix and risk heatmap. Risk Matrix by Profitbase helps risk managers, project managers, compliance teams and portfolio owners identify, assess and communicate risk in Power BI. Use it to create risk matrices, risk heatmaps, probability impact matrices, likelihood impact matrices and portfolio risk reporting that are easy to understand at a glance. When risks are spread across projects, departments or categories, it can be difficult to see where attention is needed. Risk Matrix gives teams a familiar visual framework for understanding risk exposure, severity and priority, so they can make better decisions faster. Common use cases Power BI risk matrix reporting Risk heatmaps for probability and impact analysis Risk dashboards for management and executive reporting Project risk management and portfolio risk overview Risk scoring, severity assessment and prioritization Enterprise risk management reporting Why use Risk Matrix by Profitbase? Clear visual insight Present risks in a familiar matrix format so teams can quickly understand where attention is needed. Flexible matrix setup Go beyond the standard 5x5 risk matrix. Configure the grid from 1x1 to 10x10 to match your organization’s risk assessment framework.
